premises.text: Waro helps brands and retailers increase revenue and customer acquisition by leveraging authentic video content
premises.evidence_span: Waro helps brands and retailers increase revenue and customer acquisition by leveraging authentic video content such as reviews, unboxing videos, how-to videos, and branded videos for insights and commerce.

premises.text: In-video search and personalization technologies can match videos to product catalogs
premises.evidence_span: Waro is able to match millions of videos on YouTube to product catalogs.

premises.text: Waro can search inside videos across multiple dimensions
premises.evidence_span: we can Google inside the video, the audio, text, and images in 11 plus dimensions.

premises.text: Waro increases the efficacy of making shopping decisions for brands and retailers
premises.evidence_span: we're increasing the efficacy of making shopping decisions for brands and retailers.

premises.text: Waro offers tools to make videos shoppable and searchable for brands and shoppers
premises.evidence_span: we offer a video search bar, API tools, and commerce tools to make all your videos shoppable and searchable for both brands and shoppers.

premises.text: Waro generates strong ROI by increasing page engagement and conversion rates
premises.evidence_span: Our ROI is very strong. We increase page engagement 2x to 5x, and we increase conversion by up to 38%.

value.text: Waro provides video intelligence for video commerce
value.evidence_span: Waro is video intelligence for video commerce.

notes: Traction details and demo offers excluded as they do not constitute premises.
